bio: Just a few metres from the River Loue, this bistro with red shutters has a terrace that gives onto the village square. The chef's generous traditional cuisine is a real ode to the terroir: smoked trout and preserved leek; Petit Mercey snails; poultry supreme and a vin jaune cream – served on tables with checked tablecloths in an interior packed with salvaged knick-knacks....
